sentences.text:
2. The present petition has been preferred for the Patna High Court CWJC No.17717 of 2018(5)
dt.05-01-2026 grant of following relief(s):
"for issuance of a writ in nature of Mandamus or appropriate writ/orders to direct the respondent authorities to get the encroachment on Raiyati land of petitioners removed which is caused by construction of PCC road by Government Authorities without any notice or without obtaining the land concerned in Land Acquisition Act or under any prevailing laws and without giving any compensation thereof to petitioners and without their consent and/or the petitioners further seek indulgence of this Hon'ble Court to pass such order/orders directing the concerned authorities to make payment of compensation to petitioners at present prevailing rates of the land in accordance with law as if it was an emergency acquisition, if the encroachment is not removed, and further, petitioners be also paid compensation for unnecessary harassment and sufferings as well as cost of litigation."

3. The grievance of the petitioners are that though Patna High Court CWJC No.17717 of 2018(5)
dt.05-01-2026 they had allowed limited access to the said use of 'pagdandi', it has been broaden and black soling done without their consent.
4.
Learned State counsel on the other hand dispute it and submit that for decades, it was being used for public purposes.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioners submit that it was 2 to 4 feet area that was being used but the same has been enlarged without his permission.
He submits that to settle the dust, they are ready to approach the Collector, Sheohar (respondent no.3) alongwith necessary documents to support their claim.
6. Learned State counsel has no objection.

7. In that background, the writ petition is disposed of allowing the petitioners to prefer a proper representation alongwith supporting documents before the Collector, Sheohar (respondent no.3)
within a period of four weeks and if such petition is filed, the Collector, Sheohar (respondent no.3)
shall be hearing the parties and taking the matter to its logical conclusion, at an earliest.

(Rajiv Roy, J) vinayak/-
